landing.heroTitle: Leading veterinary diagnostic imaging and neurology expertise
landing.heroBody: Supporting colleagues in practice with fast, clinically focused general imaging and neuroimaging reports.
landing.aboutBody: VetMind AI Teleradiology is a clinically focused service prototype combining DICOM upload, AI-assisted draft reports, and veterinary radiologist approval. Built to give colleagues in practice fast, structured imaging support.
landing.aboutDemo: On demo accounts, choosing a role only changes the interface; real authorization happens on the server. Default AI outputs are marked demo / synthetic; this is not a clinical production system.
landing.partnerName: VRM Imaging and Veterinary Health Services Inc.
landing.partnerBody: Clinical experience and expertise in veterinary diagnostic imaging have guided the design and development of the platform.
landing.servicesBody: Upload, analysis, and specialist review in one flow for general imaging and neuroimaging.
landing.svcDicomBody: Securely quarantine study, series and slice information; confirm species and modality.
landing.svcAiBody: Structured findings from imaging and clinical context; every output is prepared for specialist approval.
landing.svcReviewBody: The veterinary radiologist keeps clinical responsibility through approve, reject, or revision.
landing.how1: Sign in to your account or use demo credentials.
landing.how2: Upload DICOM or a demo case; confirm classification.
landing.how3: AI prepares a draft report; it is reviewed in the specialist queue.
landing.how4: The approved report is shared with the clinical team — AI does not diagnose.
landing.footer: © {year} VetMind AI · Capstone project prototype · Not a clinical production system

lessons.title: AI Lessons
lessons.subtitle: Lessons saved from revision reasons. The model is reminded of them when drafting similar cases.
lessons.how: How it works: when "Remember this correction for similar cases" is ticked in the revision dialog, your reason becomes a lesson. New drafts with the same region and species get it in the prompt (at most 3, shared findings first). Lessons never add findings and are not citable sources.
lessons.emptyText: When requesting a revision on a draft, tick "Remember this correction for similar cases".
